idea-plugin.name: Duke Engine
idea-plugin.description:
Editor support for the INI files that define content for Duke Engine, a deterministic Java RTS engine.
  • Highlighting for block headers, End, keys, values, numbers, strings and ; comments
  • Folding for Object ... End blocks and their module sub-blocks
  • Structure view listing every block and the modules inside each Object
  • Checks for unclosed blocks, stray End lines, unrecognized lines and keys set twice in one block
  • Ctrl+Click from a block name used elsewhere, such as the hero a DungeonSkill belongs to, to its definition
The plugin reads only the INI text. It does not check block types, fields or module names against the engine code.
